'''Rance''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] who operated the [[Syvris shadowport]] after retiring from a life of piracy. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] destroyed the [[Shadowport/Legends|shadowport]].
